title: Liverse
tagline: Using superfluid auction method, winners image will be displayed on the decentraland billboard.
description: Aims to create an auction-based billboard in metaverse using superfluid streams. The contract holds the winner of the auction, when the user closes the stream, the position goes to the next person with a high bid. The project is not completed due to difficulties faced to interacting with the smart contract deployed. The plan is to create a continuous stream to win the auction
how_its_made: Built the parcel (a piece of land in decentraland) and integrated it with the deployed contract. The user with the highest auction is the winner and can own the billboard.  The project is not completed due to difficulties faced to interacting with the smart contract deployed. The plan is to create a continuous stream to win the auction
